How to run it
Straight sets: do all the sets of each exercise, rest, then move to the next.
Main Circuit
Pull-ups – machine assisted
3 sets10 repsAssisted pull-up machine40kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Kneel or stand on the assist platform of the machine, hands on the bar wider than shoulders, arms extended, chest up.

Movement: Pull yourself up until the chin nears the bar, driving the elbows down, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbows and draw the shoulder blades down, not shrugging into the ears. Control the lower fully rather than dropping, and use enough assistance to move cleanly.

Deadlift – BB
3 sets8 repsBarbell40kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand with feet hip-width, the bar over mid-foot. Hinge down to grip just outside your legs, shins to the bar, chest up, back flat, shoulders slightly ahead of the bar, core braced hard.

Movement: Push the floor away and stand tall, keeping the bar dragging close to your legs, hips and shoulders rising together. Finish standing tall with the glutes, then hinge the hips back and lower the bar under control down the same line.

Focus: The back stays flat from floor to lockout, never rounded. Take the load through the legs and hips and keep the bar close to the body throughout. Don't jerk the bar or lean back at the top, just stand tall.

Seated cable row – close neutral grip
3 sets10 repsCable row machine30.25kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Sit at the low cable, feet braced, a neutral close handle, arms extended, chest up, back tall.

Movement: Pull the handle to the lower abdomen, elbows driving back close to the body, then return slowly under control.

Focus: Drive the elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades, keeping the back tall and still. Keep the shoulders down, and control the return without rocking.

External rotation – band
3 sets10 repsBandYellow band
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand side-on to a band at elbow height, elbow pinned to the side and bent to 90 degrees, forearm across the body.

Movement: Rotate the forearm outward, opening away from the body, keeping the elbow pinned, then return under control.

Focus: Keep the elbow glued to the side and move only the forearm, not the whole arm. Keep the shoulder down and the ribs still, and control the return.

Hockey ball release – glute
3 sets30 secHockey ballBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Sit on the floor with a hockey ball under one buttock, hands behind you. Cross that ankle over the opposite knee and lower your weight on gradually.

Movement: Lean into a tender spot and hold until it releases, thirty to sixty seconds. Two or three spots per side.

Focus: Pressure you can breathe through, not pain. Hold still rather than rolling about. Anything shooting, electric or numb down the leg is the nerve, so move off that spot straight away.

Prone Y raise
3 sets8 repsDBLight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie face down on a bench or mat, arms reaching out overhead in a Y, thumbs up, light or no weight.

Movement: Raise the arms off the floor towards the Y position, squeezing the lower shoulder blades, then lower under control.

Focus: Lead with the thumbs and squeeze the shoulder blades down and in, not shrugging towards the ears. Keep the neck long, use a light weight, and control the lower.

Copenhagen plank – short lever
3 sets30s each sideBenchBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie on your side with the top leg's inner knee resting on a bench, forearm down, elbow under the shoulder.

Movement: Lift the hips and the bottom leg so the body forms a straight line, supported by the knee on the bench, and hold.

Focus: Keep the hips lifted and level, not sagging, and the body in one line. Keep the shoulder stacked over the elbow, and hold only as long as the line holds.

Single leg squat – TRX
3 sets10 repsTRXBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Hold the TRX handles, stand on one leg with the other lifted in front, standing foot planted, light tension on the straps.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down on the one leg, using the straps for balance and assistance, then drive up through the heel to stand.

Focus: Keep the working knee in line with the middle toes, never caving in, and the hips level. Use the straps to share the load, keep the heel down, and control the depth.

Curtsey lunge – bodyweight
3 sets10 repsBodyweightBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, hands at the chest for balance.

Movement: Step one foot back and across behind the other into a curtsey, lowering under control, then drive back up to standing. Keep the hips fairly square.

Focus: Keep the front knee tracking over the foot, not caving inward, and lower only as far as control and knee comfort allow. Keep the chest up and the hips square rather than twisting.

On Your Own: Barbell and Finish
Note any changes on the main lifts. Tap Show pictures or Show description on a move to see how it's done.
Main Circuit
Deadlift – BB conventional
4 sets6 repsBarbell~47.5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot. Bend at the hips and knees to grip just outside the legs, shins near the bar, chest up, flat back, shoulders a touch ahead of the bar, brace the core.

Movement: Drive through the legs and push the floor away, keeping the bar close as the hips and chest rise together, to stand tall. Hinge the hips back and control the bar down the same path.

Focus: Keep the back flat throughout and the bar close to the legs. Power comes from the legs and hips, not the lower back. Don't round at the bottom or hyperextend at the top.

Chest press – cable
3 sets10 repsCable~10kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand at a chest-height cable, a handle in each hand at the chest, staggered stance, shoulder blades set, core braced.

Movement: Press the handles forward together until the arms are nearly straight, then return under control to the chest.

Focus: Keep the shoulder blades set and the ribs down, not arching to press. Keep the elbows a little below shoulder height, and control the return.

Bent-over rows – BB
4 sets8 repsBarbell~12.5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a barbell at arms' length, chest up, hips back, core braced.

Movement: Pull the bar towards the lower chest or upper abdomen, driving the elbows back, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hinge steady, not rising or rounding as you row, this protects the lower back. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and control the lower.

Walking lunges – suitcase
3 sets20mAny kitModerate
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall with a weight in one hand at your side like a suitcase, feet hip-width, ribs down, core braced, with space ahead to walk into.

Movement: Step forward into a lunge, lowering until both knees bend towards right angles, then drive through the front heel and bring the back foot through into the next lunge, holding the weight steady at your side throughout. Load one side for the set, then swap.

Focus: Resist the pull towards the weighted side, keeping the shoulders and hips level and the torso tall. Keep the front knee over the ankle, brace hard so you don't lean, and step under control.

Shoulder press – seated
3 sets10 repsAny kit~6kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Sit tall on a bench with back support, a weight in each hand at shoulder height, elbows under the wrists, ribs down.

Movement: Press the the weights overhead until the arms are straight, then lower them back to shoulder height under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the back against the support, not arching to press. Keep the shoulders down away from the ears, and lower under control to a comfortable shoulder range.

Jump squat – bodyweight
6 sets20s on 20s offBodyweightBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, knees soft, arms ready, core braced.

Movement: Squat down, then jump up, and land softly back into the squat, absorbing through the hips and knees.

Focus: Land softly and quietly with the knees tracking over the toes, not caving in. Absorb through the hips and knees, and keep each landing controlled before the next jump.

Back squat – low bar

Start: Rest the bar lower on the rear shoulders, feet shoulder-width or a touch wider, toes out, core braced hard.

Movement: Sit the hips back with a slightly forward-leaning torso, knees in line with the middle toes, to a comfortable depth, then drive up through the heels.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes and the heels down, and the back flat despite the forward lean. Brace hard to protect the lower back, and control depth to comfortable knees.

3 x 6-10 · Moderate
Power snatch – BB

Start: Stand with a barbell on the floor, feet hip-width, a wide grip, hinged with a flat back, core braced.

Movement: Drive explosively from the floor through the hips to pull the bar up and punch it overhead in one movement, catching in a partial dip, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat off the floor and drive from a sharp hip extension, keeping the bar close. Catch with the ribs down, the shoulder stable and the knees tracking over the feet, and control the lower.

3 x 6-10 · 15kg
Push press – BB

Start: Stand tall, a barbell racked at the shoulders, feet hip-width, ribs down, core and glutes braced.

Movement: Dip slightly at the knees, then drive up through the legs to help press the bar overhead, then lower under control.

Focus: Use a short controlled leg dip and drive, keeping the ribs down and not arching the back on the press. Keep the knees tracking over the feet, and control the lower to the shoulders.

3 x 6-10 · 15kg
Knee extension – cable

Start: Sit or stand with a cuff around one ankle attached to a low cable behind, the knee slightly bent.

Movement: Straighten the knee against the cable, squeezing the thigh, then let it bend back under control.

Focus: Straighten under control and squeeze the thigh, never kicking the knee straight. Keep the range comfortable and pain-free, and control the return.

3 x 8-12 · 1.5kg
Hip extension – cable

Start: Stand facing a low cable with a cuff around one ankle, holding the frame for balance, torso tall.

Movement: Drive the working leg straight back from the hip, squeezing the glute, then return under control.

Focus: Drive the movement from the glute and keep the leg fairly straight, not arching the lower back to gain range. Keep the torso tall and the standing knee soft, and control the return.

3 x 8-12 · 1.5kg
Curl and overhead extension – BB

Start: Stand tall holding a bar at the thighs with an underhand grip, elbows pinned to the sides, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Curl the bar to the shoulders, press it overhead, lower it behind the head by bending the elbows, then reverse the whole path to return.

Focus: Keep the elbows still through the curl rather than letting them travel forward, and keep the ribs down through the overhead portion rather than arching the back. Control the bar on the way back down, which is where most of the work is.

3 x 8-12 · Moderate
Dips – machine assisted

Start: Set the assist, grip the dip bars, arms straight, chest up, shoulders down, ribs down.

Movement: Bend the elbows to lower until the upper arms are about parallel, then press back up to straight arms.

Focus: Lower only to a comfortable shoulder depth, not below, to protect the shoulders. Keep the shoulders down away from the ears, the chest up, and press up under control.

3 x 8-12 · Bodyweight
Pike – Swiss ball

Start: Hands on the floor, shins or feet on a Swiss ball, body in a straight line, core braced hard.

Movement: Lift the hips towards the ceiling into a pike, rolling the ball in, then lower back to the straight line under control.

Focus: Lift from the core and control the ball, not letting the hips sag on the return. Keep the shoulders steady over the hands, and move smoothly.

3 x 8-12 · Bodyweight
Ball pass – Swiss ball, hands to feet

Start: Lie on your back, arms overhead holding a Swiss ball, legs straight, ribs down.

Movement: Lift the arms and legs to pass the ball from the hands to between the feet, lower, then pass it back the next rep.

Focus: Keep the lower back gently pressed down as the limbs meet, bracing the core. Move under control rather than flopping, and don't let the back arch at the ends.

Dead hang

Start: Reach up and take a firm overhand grip on a bar, then let the feet come off the floor (or stay lightly down) so the body hangs.

Movement: Hang with the arms straight, letting the shoulders and spine decompress, for the set time.

Focus: Let the shoulders relax rather than actively holding them, and keep the grip secure. Come down before the grip fails, and keep the body fairly still rather than swinging.

Deadlift – trap bar

Movement: Push the floor away and stand tall, hips and shoulders rising together. Finish standing tall with the glutes, then sit the hips back and lower the bar under control to the floor.

Focus: The back stays flat from floor to lockout, never rounded. Push through the whole foot with the heels down, and stand tall at the top without leaning back.

Good mornings – BB (pause)

Start: Bar across the upper back, feet hip-width, soft knees, core braced hard.

Movement: Hinge the hips back with a flat back until you feel the hamstrings, pause for two seconds at the bottom, then drive the hips forward to stand tall.

Focus: Hold the flat back through the pause, never let it round. Hinge at the hips, keep a soft knee, and only go as deep as your flat back and hamstring flexibility allow.

Movement: Pull towards the face and rotate the hands so the knuckles finish pointing up and back, elbows high, then return under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbows high and add the rotation from the shoulders, not shrugging. Keep the ribs down and the torso still, and control the return.

Z-press – BB

Start: Sit on the floor, legs straight out in front, a barbell at the shoulders, sitting tall, ribs down, core braced hard.

Movement: Press the bar overhead until the arms are straight, then lower to the shoulders under control while staying upright.

Focus: Keep sitting tall with the ribs down, not leaning back or arching, which the seated position exposes. Keep the shoulders down, and press within a comfortable overhead range.

Movement: Take the working leg out to the side against the band, keeping it straight, then return under control.

Focus: Keep the leg straight and the torso tall, not leaning to lift, and the hips level. Lead with the heel, keep it slow, and feel the outer hip.

Wrist extension – isometric hold

Start: Sit with the forearm resting along a thigh or bench, palm facing down, wrist straight and the hand free over the edge. Place the other hand lightly over the back of it.

Movement: Press the back of the hand gently up into the other hand and hold, keeping the wrist straight throughout, then release slowly and rest before the next hold.

Focus: Nothing moves. The wrist stays straight and simply resists, so the muscles work without the joint travelling into the position that hurts. Build the pressure gradually and ease off just as gradually.

Wrist flexion – supported

Movement: Lift the hips and bottom leg into a straight line, supported by the top foot, and hold for the set time.

Focus: Keep the hips lifted and level, not sagging, through the longer, harder lever. Keep the shoulder stacked over the elbow, and shorten to the knee version if the hips can't hold.

3 x 20s each · Bodyweight
w/c 20 Jul 2026 · Wrist-first strength▼
Pull-ups – band assisted

Start: Set up with assistance from a band or partner, hands wider than shoulders on the bar, arms extended, chest up.

Movement: Pull yourself up until the chin nears the bar, driving the elbows down, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbows and draw the shoulder blades down, not shrugging. Control the lower fully, and use enough assistance to keep the movement clean.

3 x 8 · 40kg
Back squat – BB

Start: Set the bar across the upper back on the traps, hands gripping evenly, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Brace the core hard and unrack, stepping back to a stable stance.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down, bending the knees, until the thighs reach a comfortable depth, keeping the chest up and the bar over mid-foot. Drive up through the heels to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking out over the toes, never caving in, and the heels planted throughout. Keep the chest up and the core braced so the back stays flat, and take depth only to where you keep good form and comfortable knees.

2 x 10 · 25kg
Romanian deadlift – BB

Start: Stand tall with a barbell held at the front of your thighs, hands just outside your legs, feet hip-width. Set the shoulders back, brace the core hard, and keep a soft bend in the knees.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the bar down the front of your legs, keeping it in contact, until you feel a strong stretch in the hamstrings. Keep the knees still and the shins vertical. Drive the hips forward to stand tall and finish with the glutes.

Focus: The back stays flat from start to finish, never rounded. This is a hip hinge, not a squat, so the movement happens at the hips while the bar tracks close to the legs. Only lower as far as you can hold a flat back, and don't lean back or over-arch at the top.

3 x 10 · 25kg
DB single-arm press

Start: Stand or sit tall, a dumbbell at one shoulder, ribs down, core braced against the offset load.

Movement: Press the dumbbell overhead until the arm is straight, then lower back to the shoulder under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and resist leaning away from the weight, staying upright. Keep the shoulder down away from the ear, and press within a comfortable range.

2 x 10 each · 7kg
Bent-over row – BB underhand

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a barbell underhand at arms' length, chest up, hips back, core braced.

Movement: Pull the bar towards the lower abdomen, driving the elbows back close to the body, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hinge steady, not rounding as you row. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and keep the wrists straight.

3 x 10 · 15kg
Hip abduction machine

Start: Sit at the machine, the outer thighs against the pads, back supported, feet on the rests.

Movement: Push the thighs apart against the pads, then return slowly under control.

Focus: Push apart smoothly and control the return, not letting the pads snap the legs together. Keep the back settled and the movement steady, feeling the outer hips.

3 x 12 · 35.75kg
Pallof press – standing lunge

Start: Stand side-on to a cable or band at chest height in a split stance, one foot forward in a shallow lunge, hands at the chest, core braced.

Movement: Press the handle straight out in front of you, resisting the pull that wants to twist you, hold briefly, then draw it back.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square over the split stance, letting nothing rotate you towards the cable. The lunge stance narrows your base, so the anti-rotation job gets harder. Keep the ribs down and press smoothly.

3 x 10 each side · Red band

Assisted pull-up

Start: Set up on the assisted pull-up machine or with a band, overhand grip wider than shoulders, arms extended, chest up.

Movement: Pull yourself up until the chin nears the bar, driving the elbows down, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbows and keep the shoulder blades drawing down, not shrugging. Control the lower fully, and set the assistance so the movement stays clean.

To burn x2 · 40kg
Back squat – high bar

Start: Rest the bar high on the traps, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out, core braced hard, standing tall after unracking.

Movement: Sit down with a fairly upright torso, knees tracking forward over the toes, to a comfortable depth, then drive up through the heels to stand.

Focus: Keep the knees over the toes and the heels down, chest tall throughout. Keep the core braced to protect the back, and control the depth to your comfortable range.

3 x 6 · 20kg
Hip thrust – BB

Start: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, a padded barbell across the front of your hips. Feet flat, hip-width, shins vertical when the hips are up. Tuck the chin slightly and brace the core.

Movement: Drive through your heels and push the hips up until the thighs are level and the body makes a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze the glutes hard at the top, hold, then lower with control.

Focus: Finish the lift with the glutes at a straight line, don't over-arch the lower back to gain height. Keep the ribs down and the chin tucked so the movement stays in the hips, not the back. Shins stay roughly vertical at the top.

3 x 10 · 20kg
Single leg Romanian deadlift

Start: Stand on one leg holding a weight, the other leg ready to travel back, torso tall, standing knee soft.

Movement: Hinge from the hip, pushing it back as the weight lowers along the leg and the free leg travels back, then return.

Focus: Push the hip back with a flat back and keep the hips level, feeling the hamstring. Keep the standing knee soft, move slowly, and control the return.

To burn each side · 8kg
DB single-arm press

Start: Stand or sit tall, a dumbbell at one shoulder, ribs down, core braced against the offset load.

Movement: Press the dumbbell overhead until the arm is straight, then lower back to the shoulder under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and resist leaning away from the weight, staying upright. Keep the shoulder down away from the ear, and press within a comfortable range.

3 x 10 each · 7kg then 6kg
Single arm row – DB

Start: Hand and knee on a bench, the other foot planted, a dumbbell in the free hand hanging down, back flat and level.

Movement: Pull the dumbbell towards the hip, driving the elbow back and up, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbow and squeeze the shoulder blade, keeping the back flat and level, not twisting to lift. Keep the shoulder down, and control the lower.

3 x 10 each · Moderate
Farmer's carries

Start: Stand tall holding a heavy weight in each hand at the sides, feet hip-width, ribs down, shoulders back.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the torso tall and steady.

Focus: Stand tall with the ribs down and shoulders back, not letting the weights pull you into a slump. Take steady steps, brace the core, and keep the weights from swinging.

3 x 30s · 2 x 14kg
Pallof press

Start: Stand side-on to a cable or band at chest height, feet shoulder-width, hands holding the handle at the chest, core braced.

Movement: Press the handle straight out in front of you, resisting the pull that wants to rotate you, hold briefly, then draw it back.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square, letting nothing rotate you towards the cable, this is the whole exercise. Keep the ribs down and the core braced, and press smoothly rather than snatching.

2 x 10 each · Light
Wall push-up

Start: Stand facing a wall, hands flat on it at shoulder height and width, arms straight, body in a line leaning in slightly.

Movement: Bend the elbows to bring the chest towards the wall, then press back to straight arms, keeping the body in a line.

Focus: Keep the body in a straight line, not sagging at the hips. Keep the elbows tucked and the shoulders down, and control the movement, stepping the feet back to make it harder.

3 x 10 · Bodyweight
